# Comparison report: the synthetic town and Petaling district (official open data)

*2026-10-17. Generated by `data/scripts/calibrate_day.py` from `data/sim/elmina/calibration.json`.*

## Why

Elmina Day rehearses a day of **5,000 synthetic residents**. A judge will ask how we know they
look like Elmina. Elmina's residents are not observed (and their personal data is not wanted),
but City of Elmina lies in **Petaling district, Selangor**, and the government publishes open data
for it. This compares the synthetic town with the district. **Nothing is fitted:** the gap is
measured and reported, here and in the Day panel ("How it was made → Compared with Petaling").

## Sources (CC BY 4.0, cached in `data/cache/opendata/`)

| Dataset | URL | Size | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DOSM, Population by district, sex, age group and ethnicity (population_district) | https://storage.dosm.gov.my/population/population_district.parquet | 264,746 B | CC BY 4.0 |
| MOE (EMIS) via data.gov.my, Enrolment in government schools by district | https://api.data.gov.my/data-catalogue?id=enrolment_school_district&ifilter=selangor@state&limit=5000 | 103,456 B | CC BY 4.0 |
| data.gov.my, Number of government schools by district | https://api.data.gov.my/data-catalogue?id=schools_district&ifilter=selangor@state&limit=5000 | 36,693 B | CC BY 4.0 |

Petaling, 2025: **2,370,700 people**; **147,974** primary
and **101,560** secondary pupils in **150** primary and
**77** secondary government schools (MOE district offices Petaling Perdana and Petaling Utama).

## What the comparison found first: a bug

Before Cycle 21, **every child under 13, toddlers included, went on a primary-school run** and was
counted as a pupil: 293 of 674 households with children drove to a primary school with no one
aged 7-12 (Standard 1-6). The storm day reported 1,373 pupils (about 275 per 1,000 residents).
Fixed: a school run only when a child aged 7-12 lives in the home; under-7s ride along only with
a parent who is home. The demo numbers were re-measured.

## The synthetic town and Petaling (2025)

| What | Synthetic town | Petaling district |
|---|---|---|
| Ages 0-14 | 23.3% | 19.1% |
| Ages 15-64 | 67.4% | 71.8% |
| Ages 65+ | 9.2% | 9.0% |
| Children aged 7-12 per 1,000 residents | 92.0 | about 82.8 (from 5-year age bands) |
| Teenagers aged 13-17 per 1,000 residents | 72.4 | about 66.2 (from 5-year age bands) |
| Pupils per 1,000 residents (primary / secondary) | 92.0 / 72.4 (every school-age resident goes to a mapped school, government or private) | 62.4 / 42.8 in government schools only |

Inputs, not checks: household size 3.77 (input: DOSM Census 2020, 3.8,
Malaysia); households with a car 91.5% (input: DOSM household survey 2024, 92.3%, Malaysia).

## How to read it

- The synthetic town has fewer people aged 50-64 (-9.7 points) and more aged 80+ (+2.0 points) than Petaling: its household generator makes parents 26-50 and adds older grandparents, so there are few older commuters.
- Enrolment counts government schools only (MOE EMIS). Dividing it by the age-band estimate gives roughly 75% (7-12) and 65% (13-17) in government schools; the rest may be in private, international or religious schools, schooled in another district, or non-citizens. These are rough ratios, not facts about children.
- Petaling is a proxy: it is the wider urban district (Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam), and Elmina is one new township in it, which may be younger.
- The generator's inputs (Malaysia-wide age shares, household size, car ownership) are DOSM figures, so they are not checks; only the Petaling comparison is.
- Years: the district comparison uses 2025, the latest year with enrolment data.
- Nothing is fitted to these figures: they measure the gap, and the gap is reported.

What has no public figure for Elmina (trip timing, workplaces, how residents choose under a
flood) stays a stated assumption in the Day panel: the knobs a pilot would replace with SDP's own
resident data, with consent.

## Reproduce

```bash
uv sync --all-packages --all-groups   # pyarrow is in the data group
uv run python data/scripts/calibrate_day.py
uv run pytest data/scripts/tests/test_calibrate_day.py -q
```
